config.description: Open-world text-to-3D on CPU: native vs Shap-E vs auto vs planner (frozen before any candidate run)

evaluator.model: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 (not ViT-L/14, which conditions Shap-E)

training_performed: none for native/Shap-E/zimage-triposr; see the anchor-LoRA model card for zimage-triposr-anchorlora
router: native iff every content word is in its vocabulary; otherwise the first available of shap-e-text300m > zimage-triposr (E-T3 evidence order, D-029)
hardware_note: Shap-E CPU and GPU units use the same weights, 16 steps, fp32 sampling and the same initial noise (seeded CPU generator); they are not bitwise identical (different kernels). zimage-triposr runs only on a GPU. Every row records its device

excluded_infrastructure.exclusion_reason: infrastructure: SIGTERM from the host memory watchdog while the operator ran test and check processes concurrently with this worker (system-wide MemAvailable fell under ~0.8 GB); not a model outcome. The unit is re-run.
